cache_limitation: full-resolution binary masks and display-only192 probability previews; no full-resolution soft probability experiments from previews
prediction_information: current image, own preprocessing metadata and frozen models/caches only; no evaluator transform, original counterpart, GT, image_id rules or other-image predictions

split.strata: dataset set x strict/wide/no similarity tier
split.allocation: sort connected components by salted SHA256; first floor(number_of_components/3) in each stratum are development; remainder confirmation
split.evaluation_status: within-round locked confirmation; previously observed data, not independent new-patient blind test

implementation_requirements.V: reuse frozen image-only ROI with3% margin, separately honor known own network padding; do not resize masks or use benchmark inverse transform to find valid area; tag ROI fallback
implementation_requirements.C: same raw boundary mask/run centres, no new mask interpolation; normalize all track linking/gap/min support/fit constraints to ROI coordinates, use covered interval length not sample count; reference ROI width1046 already frozen in Round37
implementation_requirements.Q: explicit ordered supported pair and image-domain checks; confident C1 contradiction blocks normal measurement; absent C1 alone is not a negative boundary label; zero score never silently treated as confident; preserve exploratory output and reason
implementation_requirements.E: retain fitting estimator and observed support; replace terminal fitting window based on varying track span with existing0.25 fraction of fixed ROI width; never label extension as observed support
implementation_requirements.W: FL only; retain per-track intersections/eligibility/dedup/quality/kernel; region influence proportional to nominal25/50/25 times m/(m+lambda), m=sum quality times continuous spatial kernel; independent region coverage remains separate and missing is not filled
implementation_requirements.S: FL only; same Huber delta1.5, replace per-image adaptive MAD with one frozen normalized scale; retain0.01ROI floor; preserve real anatomy variation, no output clipping
implementation_requirements.calibration: lambda and FL normalized scale are deterministic medians of development-original per-image evidence/MAD, averaging seeds within image before cohort median; no GT or stability scores; each image one contribution; one configuration, no grid search
implementation_requirements.before_confirmation: must freeze precise formulas, all constants, eligibility thresholds, code hashes and source bindings after development implementation tests; no confirmation run until this lock exists

inherited_constants_not_claimed_optimal.C1_gate_source: Round36 existing evidence gate, gate only; do not also switch ranking formula
inherited_constants_not_claimed_optimal.zero_score_policy: distinguish absent C1 from contradictory C1; require independent boundary support, record boundary-only/ambiguous reason; never label an unsupported fallback as normal MT
inherited_constants_not_claimed_optimal.calibration_parameter_search_budget: none; two scale constants by deterministic development-only statistics, all other constants inherited; any rule redesign requires amendment before confirmation

primary_endpoint: paired difference in per-image joint pass fraction on frozen confirmation images, denominator fixed by Round38 R original-complete457/458 cohort restricted to partition

statistics.sampling_unit: connected source/similarity component; seeds reported separately, never independent patients
statistics.bootstrap: paired component resampling stratified by dataset-set, all images and transforms kept together; report95% intervals for deltas
statistics.primary_comparison: J-B0 only; all single-factor comparisons mechanistic secondary, no posthoc winner substituted
statistics.multiplicity: no confirmatory significance claims from the arm ranking; any formal secondary testing requires prespecified Holm family before results
statistics.natural_pairs: same117 nonidentical and18 strict pairs; group equal; pairs with either endpoint missing counted separately; no claim that true anatomy must be identical
statistics.small_sample: report component counts, event numerators and broad intervals; bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not proof of population or unseen-patient reliability

decision_rules.stage_improvement: both seeds: paired confirmation joint-pass improvement interval lower bound>0, original complete count not below B0, paired missing/extreme point estimates not worse; natural group FL and missing must not worsen relative to B0; also disclose R/A comparisons
decision_rules.overall_stable: both seeds meet frozen95% joint target and1% missing target, coverage not below frozen R; no known structural-invalid normal outputs; full and natural-group evidence concordant, no claim from point estimates alone
decision_rules.natural_no_harm: natural FL group-equal change versusB0 upper paired95% interval<=0 to support no-worsening; if too imprecise state inconclusive; comparison toR mandatory and any residualR regression prevents claiming historical similarity stability restored
decision_rules.rejection_only: fewer extreme numbers but more missing is anomaly blocking, not whole-chain stability improvement
decision_rules.tradeoff: controlled-transform improvement with natural-pair regression is partial benefit, not success
decision_rules.no_effect: interval includes zero -> insufficient evidence, not proof of equivalence
decision_rules.accuracy: secondary cost only; never tune using external34 expert numbers or boundary reference on confirmation

implementation_controls: construct support-coordinate invariance without mask resampling
ROI/reference clipping audit on both boundaries, labels used only for evaluation
same candidate set: sweep one candidate influence continuously0to1
same boundary/segments: change terminal observed support only
known true thickness/angle changes must remain
no cross-image averaging or constant/fallback filling
same nonfinite/missing denominators for all arms
